Vignetting of the three lenses over the sensor's diagonal through the centre $\mathfrak{c}$ of the learned profile, every curve divided by its value at $\mathfrak{c}$: the flat field of a diffuser photograph, the vignetting our refinement learned, and the thin lens model's $\cos^4\alpha$. The learned vignetting, written $V_{\mathrm{ours}}$, agrees with the flat field $V_{\mathrm{flat}}$ to (median, mean and RMS of $|\ln(V_{\mathrm{ours}} / V_{\mathrm{flat}})|$ along the diagonal: Sigma 14\,mm lens, $f/4$: 0.004, 0.009, 0.014; fisheye lens, $f/4$: 0.033, 0.052, 0.071; Tamron 20\,mm lens, $f/2.8$: 0.036, 0.053, 0.075).
